title: Dining Plan Schedule of Monthly Plan Fees and Meal Credits
content:
The Dining Plan is offered to Larkspur independent living residents in six plans. Each plan has a monthly plan fee, stated in US dollars per calendar month and billed in advance, and a number of meal credits granted on the first day of each month in which the plan is active.

## Schedule

| Plan | Monthly plan fee (USD per calendar month, billed in advance) | Meal credits granted on the first day of each active month |
|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 169.00 | 10 |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 249.00 | 15 |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 479.00 | 30 |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 699.00 | 45 |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 905.00 | 60 |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 1299.00 | 90 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The monthly plan fee is a charge for the calendar month, not for a run of thirty days, and it is billed in advance of the month it covers.
2. The meal credits shown are the month's grant. They are granted on the first day of a month, and only for a month in which the plan is active.
3. Each row stands on its own: a plan's fee and its credit grant go together, and no figure of one plan applies to another.

## Reading the schedule

- *What does the Dining 45 Meal Plan cost each month, and how many credits does it grant?* 699.00 US dollars for the calendar month, billed in advance, with 45 meal credits granted on the first day of each active month.
- *Which plan grants the most credits?* The Dining Full Board Plan, with 90 meal credits a month for a monthly plan fee of 1299.00 US dollars.
- *Hypothetical comparison:* a resident weighing the Dining 30 Meal Plan against the Dining 60 Meal Plan is comparing 30 credits for 479.00 US dollars with 60 credits for 905.00 US dollars a month; the difference between the two is 426.00 US dollars and 30 credits a month.
